items.summary: CRO handoff: retain no new proposals or queue admissions this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, 39 improvements await measurement, 21 requests failed, and only 6 outcomes are proven. Preserve existing allthingsmasonic.com request 4719e525-763b-42a4-9f16-e71e1c38b17b as the next revenue experiment after capacity and site-overlap clearance. Evidence baseline for 2026-09-21: 61 affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, 0 shipped items, and $0 site-attributed commission; Amazon’s $4.92 aggregate commission cannot be assigned to a site. Experiment: clarify product CTAs and disclosure placement without changing destinations, tracking, or claims. Metric: affiliate clicks and attributable ordered/shipped items over 14 days or 100 relevant impressions/clicks; causal lift and ROI remain unknown. Rollback: revert the isolated CTA diff if validation or accessibility checks fail.

CRO deferred opportunity register for CEO/CTO review after capacity clears: (1) SEO/content prototype using microsoft/markitdown. Evidence: MIT license, bounded lab review completed with 8/8 checks passed, no dependency installation or production access. Fleet use case: convert approved source documents into structured Markdown for internal content briefs and metadata QA. Smallest reversible prototype: disposable-workspace conversion of a fixed sample, with no publication. Metric: brief-preparation time and QA defect count; time-to-learn: one engineer cycle. Risks: parser coverage, upstream maintenance, dependency/supply-chain review, and source-rights constraints. (2) Accessible component prototype using shadcn-ui/ui. Evidence: MIT license and 3/3 bounded lab checks passed; no production adoption evidence. Fleet use case: reusable CTA, disclosure, focus-state, and responsive patterns. Smallest prototype: isolated static component fixture against one existing site surface. Metric: accessibility defects and implementation cycle time; time-to-learn: one engineer cycle. Risks: framework/runtime compatibility, copied-component maintenance, dependency review, and visual regression. Both remain research leads only; no deployment, spend, credentials, domains, telemetry, or adoption is authorized.
